comparisons.reason: The two features have different exclusion predicates and different empty-list rules. Feature 0 returns 1 only if every comment is purely abstract and none uses a specific verifiable procedural example (a procedure, process, rule or practice). Feature 59 requires at least one logical refutation and no specific empirical evidence (statistics, data, studies, documented factual cases). A procedural example is not the same as empirical evidence. Feature 59 also needs a logical refutation to be present, while feature 0 does not. An empty list gives null for feature 0 and 0 for feature 59.
